title: Quantitative Mass Gap Lower Bound for SU(3) Yang-Mills

tests.name: Mass gap formula consistency
tests.details: m = R_cont * sqrt(sigma) = 3.405 * 440.0 = 1498.2 MeV; sqrt(sigma) = hbar_c/R_stella = 440.0 MeV

tests.name: Error propagation
tests.details: dm = 102.6 MeV (stated: 103.0 MeV); dR/R = 0.62%, dsigma/sigma = 6.82% (sigma dominates: True); dc/c = 4.5%

tests.name: Lambda_QCD definition
tests.details: Lambda_MSbar(Nf=0) = 243.0 MeV, Lambda_PDG(Nf=5) = 210.0 MeV (distinct: True); b0 = 0.069658, b1 = 0.00409035

tests.name: Explicit constant c
tests.details: c(Necco-Sommer) = 6.77 +/- 0.54; c(direct Nf=0) = 6.17; c(PDG Nf=5) = 7.13; reasonable range: True

tests.name: Conservative 3-sigma lower bound
tests.details: R_low(3sigma) = 3.342; (sigma/Lambda)_low = 1.51; c_low = 5.05; m_lower = 1228 MeV; positive: True, meaningful (>3): True

tests.name: Consistency with Thm 7.7.2
tests.details: m(7.7.3) = c*Lambda = 1645 MeV; m(7.7.2) = 1498 MeV; ratio = 1.098; consistent (<15%): True

tests.name: Physical reasonableness
tests.details: MP1999: 1710.0 MeV (1.5sigma); AT2020: 1651.0 MeV (1.5sigma); in range [0.9, 3.0] GeV: True

tests.name: Constant c is truly explicit
tests.details: c = 6.7704 +/- 0.5425 (explicit numerical value); finite: True, positive: True, error explicit: True

tests.name: Scheme dependence handled
tests.details: c(MSbar) = 6.17, c(lattice) = 177.56 (scheme-dependent: True); scheme specified in theorem: True; m = c*Lambda invariant: True

tests.name: String tension convention consistency
tests.details: m(CG, sigma=440) = 1498 MeV; m(quenched, sigma=485) = 1651 MeV; R_cont same: True (CG: 3.405, Q: 3.405); rel_diff = 9.3% (convention-dependent)

tests.name: Lattice MC input transparency
tests.details: MC inputs: 2 (all cited with uncertainties); Framework results: 4 (independent of MC); No circularity: True

tests.name: Lower bound survives parameter variation
tests.details: Monte Carlo (1000 samples): c = 6.80 +/- 0.55; min(c) = 5.16; 3sigma lower = 5.15; all positive: True; meaningful (>3): True

tests.name: Inherited caveats (6 items)
tests.details: All 6 inherited caveats acknowledged in §8.3 and §8.2

tests.name: No circular reasoning
